install_steps: pip install vllm  # or: uv pip install vllm
note: Python 3.9-3.12 required; a CUDA GPU is strongly recommended (CPU support exists via VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=empty builds). Docker alternative: docker run --gpus all -p 8000:8000 vllm/vllm-openai:latest --model <hf-id>. Large download (~2GB+) including PyTorch.
